svg.title: Read a search hit: identity, coverage, and interpretation
svg.desc: Synthetic protein example, not a BLAST run. The 20-amino-acid query MKTAYIAKQRQISFVKSHFS has a ten-column local alignment at query positions 4 through 13, AYIAKQRQIS, against subject positions 21 through 30, AYIAKQKQIS. Nine columns match, giving 90 percent identity but only 50 percent query coverage. No E-value or bit score is fabricated. A local match alone does not establish a protein's function.
svg.text: High identity can cover only part of a query
Synthetic protein example · positions are 1-based and inclusive · not a real database result

It does not by itself show the same whole-protein function or explain a cell-culture phenotype.
